mapper.select: SELECT ti.id, ti.asset_id, ti.forward_arm_length, ti.backward_arm_length, ti.max_height, ti.rated_load, ti.max_load, ti.rated_moment, ti.create_time, ti.update_time, eq.asset_name, eq.platform_eq_code, loc.location_name FROM equipment_assets eq INNER JOIN tower_info ti ON ti.asset_id = eq.asset_id LEFT JOIN equipment_location loc ON eq.location_id = loc.location_id WHERE eq.type_id = #{typeId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_times, IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, end_time)), 0) AS total_work_time, IFNULL(SUM(weight), 0) AS total_load, IFNULL(SUM(max_percent), 0) AS total_effect FROM tower_work WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND start_time >= CURDATE() AND start_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
